issue.title: Defective product delivered
issue.description: A defective mobile phone was delivered and the refund was not processed.

facts: Consumer purchased a mobile phone from the e-commerce platform.
The product delivered was defective and non-functional.
Refund request was submitted but not processed within the promised timeline.
rights: Consumer may have a right to receive a refund or replacement for defective goods.

laws.title: Protection Against Defective Goods
laws.explanation: Dummy legal information for testing consumer rights.

recommended_actions: Preserve all purchase receipts and communication records.
File a formal complaint with the consumer forum.
relief_requested: Full refund of the purchase amount.
